title: North America healthtech AI trust and FinOps submission gate
summary: A six-gate, no-PHI coordination aid for healthtech teams preparing a patient-access, AI vendor security questionnaire, HIPAA/privacy adviser question queue or cloud/LLM cost response.
decision_rule: Mark each response ready, adviser review or hold. Hold when workflow scope, data boundary, evidence owner, exception path or cost owner is unclear; do not assert compliance, certification, savings or outcomes without qualified review and verifiable evidence.
gates: security-questionnaire evidence owner and review date
patient-access exception queue and manual fallback
named approver and submit/hold decision log
evidence_boundary: Synthetic/no-PHI buyer education only. Not legal, privacy, security, clinical, HIPAA/BAA or procurement advice; not a certification, vendor ranking, customer case study, testimonial, logo, demand, lead, savings, ROI, revenue or patient-outcome claim.
